ui.about_lead: Igitabo cy'ikirere kidasaba murandasi ariko kigira ubuzima mu gihe nyacyo igihe ubisabye. Uko ikirere gisanzwe kimeze ku isi hose byabitswe mbere kandi bisomwa nta murandasi; uko ikirere kimeze ubu, iteganyagihe, imiburo n'inzego z'amashusho bikurwa gusa igihe ubisabye.

ui.about_privacy: Utudomo tw'urugo rwawe n'urufunguzo rwa OpenWeatherMap bibikwa gusa muri iyi porogaramu y'ishakisha kandi ntibyoherezwa ahandi na hamwe. Porogaramu itangira nta murandasi na hato; ihuza n'ikoranabuhanga gusa igihe usabye amakuru mu gihe nyacyo, yohereza gusa aho uri (coordinates) bikenewe.
ui.about_foot: Weatherglass — ni ubuntu kandi ikorera cyane cyane nta murandasi. Buri makuru agaragaza igihe yafashwe; iyo nta murandasi uhari, uko bisanzwe byabitswe mbere ni byo bigaragara.

ui.disc_body:
Weatherglass ni igikoresho gitanga amakuru, si serivisi y'umutekano. Amakuru y'ikirere, iteganyagihe, inkuru z'amateka n'imiburo ya kirimbuzi bikurwa mu masoko atari ay'iyi porogaramu (Open-Meteo, MET Norway, ikigo cy'Amerika gishinzwe ikirere, ibigo by'ibihugu bishinzwe ikirere, GDACS, na OpenWeatherMap igihe wongeyeho urufunguzo rwawe). Ayo makuru ashobora gutinda, kuba adahagije, kuba atari yo, cyangwa kutaboneka, kandi Weatherglass ashobora kuyasobanura nabi cyangwa ntiyabashe kuyagaragaza.

Ntukoreshe iyi porogaramu mu gufata ibyemezo aho ubuzima, ubuzima bwiza, umutungo cyangwa umutekano w'urugendo bishobora kuba biri mu kaga — harimo umuyaga mwinshi, umwuzure, indege, ubwato, kugenda mu misozi cyangwa imirimo yo hanze. Buri gihe kurikiza amabwiriza y'ikigo cyawe cy'igihugu gishinzwe ikirere n'ay'ubuzimagatozi; imiburo yabyo ifite agaciro kurusha ikindi cyose kigaragara hano.

Igitabo cy'ikirere kidasaba murandasi kigaragaza impuzandengo z'igihe kirekire (1991–2020) n'inkuru z'amateka. Gisobanura uko ikirere gisanzwe kimeze, ntabwo ari uko kizaba kimeze ku munsi runaka.

Aho uri bikoreshwa gusa igihe ubikanze kugira ngo bikoreshwe, gusa kugira ngo hakurwe amakuru y'ikirere kuri iryo hantu, kandi ntibyigera bibikwa natwe. Utudomo tw'urugo rwawe n'igenamiterere byawe bigumana kuri iyi mudasobwa cyangwa telefoni.

Weatherglass itangwa ku buntu, “uko iri”, nta cyizigiro cy'ubwoko ubwo ari bwo bwose. Mu buryo bunini amategeko yemerera, uwayikoze ntiyemera inshingano ku byago cyangwa igihombo cyavuka mu gukoresha iyi porogaramu cyangwa mu kwizera ibirimo.

Ukanze kuri Ndabyumva kandi ndabyemeye uba wemeje ko wasomye iri tangazo. Rigaragara indi mpinduka nshya zose zibaye.
